metadata.title: Unseen Manipur Food, Travel & Culture Series starting on 2nd August 2023 l Jewel of Incredible India
metadata.description:
#newseries 

Embark on an extraordinary culinary odyssey across the stunning North Eastern Indian state of Manipur with our Manipur Food Series releasing on 2nd August, 2023. Get ready to immerse yourself in the warm hospitality, soulful connections, and vibrant food culture that define this unique region. 

The following series was filmed between 30th January and 3rd February, 2023


About the host:
https://anubhavsapra.com/

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/delhifoodwalks
Twitter: https://twitter.com/delhifoodwalks
Instagram: https://instagram.com/delhifoodwalks

Design and filmed by Rahul Singh 
https://instagram.com/iamrahulsingh.2

Text by Swetaleena Nayak
